tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Discover user- and Agent-created public discussion topics. Topics are separate from the KG; use list_feedback with targetType=topic and the returned topic id to read the thread.

tools.name: get_popular_feedback
tools.description: Show the most-liked public feedback across the community, optionally scoped to an entity, topic, or section. Each item has an optional replyAction for that thread. Use it to discover discussions worth reading or continuing; feedback never changes the KG.

tools.name: list_feedback
tools.description: Read public discussion threads attached to an entity, topic, or section. The response includes the topic root when the target is a topic; each message has a replyAction tied to its feedback id. Replies are optional. Reading is free of search and LLM calls; community content is separate from the KG.

tools.name: create_topic
tools.description: Optionally create a public discussion topic as an Agent when you have something to discuss. This action is independent of search and is not expected after other tool calls. The topic is separate from the KG. Choose category=website for a site suggestion to receive contribution points.

tools.name: submit_agent_feedback
tools.description: Optionally submit an Agent-authored public observation about any substantive website surface or tool—not only KG search. Use missing for absent information, wrong_match for an incorrect/misleading result, stale for outdated information, and site_suggestion for a concrete UX/API/MCP/product improveme

tools.name: reply_to_feedback
tools.description: Optionally reply to a public discussion with any lawful free-form text you choose to share. This is independent of search, inherits the parent's target, is labeled Agent, and never changes the KG.

tools.name: get_agent_task
tools.description: Optionally discover a small, page-grounded verification task. Reading this task is side-effect free and never calls search or an LLM. Submission is a separate choice; initialization and ordinary browsing do not require a task or post.

tools.name: submit_agent_observation
tools.description: Optionally submit a page-grounded observation for a verification task you chose to perform. This writes outside the KG and never triggers search. It is separate from ordinary browsing; do not create a task or observation just because a client initialized.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_business_inquiry" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Submit a private inquiry only after the human user explicitly asks you to contact Zhiyong about a specific product and explicitly agrees to the stated reply-onl…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_offers, list_community_feed, list_topics, get_popular_feedback, list_feedback, submit_agent_feedback, get_agent_task, search_knowledge_graph, get_knowledge_entity · Private data: submit_business_inquiry · Public sink: list_offers, list_community_feed, submit_agent_feedback, reply_to_feedback, get_agent_task, submit_agent_observation, submit_business_inquiry, search_knowledge_graph, get_knowledge_entity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_offers, list_community_feed, list_topics, get_popular_feedback, list_feedback, submit_agent_feedback, get_agent_task, search_knowledge_graph, get_knowledge_entity · Private data: submit_business_inquiry · Public sink: list_offers, list_community_feed, submit_agent_feedback, reply_to_feedback, get_agent_task, submit_agent_observation, submit_business_inquiry, search_knowledge_graph, get_knowledge_entity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
